video_title: Bucks WON the Giannis Trade??? Giannis Traded to Heat Reactions

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Bucks acquired valuable young assets and draft picks for Giannis
quotes.excerpt: Milwaukee got exactly what they need to get. They got players that can help them now.
quotes.quote: I think it's a great trade for both. Milwaukee gets a bunch of young assets. They get three starting-level players, three really valuable picks, including one of the draft, the 13th pick tonight, could end up being a rotational player as early as this year. When you look at the haul that they brought in for a 31-year-old aging superstar who has had some health issues this year, Milwaukee got exactly what they need to get. They got players that can help them now, players that match their timeline, and a bunch of future picks they can continue to build and to grow with.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Heat acquired their franchise cornerstone in Giannis Antetokounmpo
quotes.excerpt: They now have their franchise piece, they have their superstar, everything they were looking for.
quotes.quote: I'm actually okay with both sides. I think both sides got a fair deal out of this. Obviously, Miami got the superstar that they wanted in Giannis. They now have their franchise piece, they have their superstar, everything they were looking for to build around moving forward. So, I'm sure they're happy with the results.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Bucks secured a solid return in the Giannis trade
quotes.excerpt: I think they came out of this trade pretty solid.
quotes.quote: I think they came out of this trade pretty solid. Like Chandler just mentioned, you got three starter-level guys, all-star quality, and Tyler Herro, and you get picks, and you get an opportunity to go get some young guys as well. So for a team to hit the reset button, to have the assets that you have to move you forward, you are in pretty good standing to start, based on where this deal took you.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis thrives when surrounded by shooters and defenders
quotes.excerpt: The best version of Giannis that we see, he's usually surrounded by shooters and he's surrounded by defenders.
quotes.quote: I know the best version of Giannis that we see, he's usually surrounded by shooters and he's surrounded by defenders. I want to see what else Miami does to kind of tighten up this roster. As both you guys just mentioned, Norman Powell is likely out, probably won't be re-signing, that puts that in limbo. Andrew Wiggins, where does he stand with his team? How do they build out those key pieces around your superstars that's going to get you an opportunity to compete in the Eastern Conference?

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Bucks have a deeper roster despite losing Giannis
quotes.excerpt: It's interesting to me that the Bucks, when you look at their rosters right now, they're way deeper.
quotes.quote: Ware has a chance to be an all-star in this league talent-wise, length-wise. Jaquez has proven his time in the league that he's a valuable player. And Tyler Herro has already been an all-star that is an absolute bucket who is going to be the centerpiece of this offense going forward with Ryan Rollins. And when you look at the Milwaukee Bucks roster, you look at guys like AJ Green, Prince, Portis, Trent, Jackson, Harris, those are the type of vet role players that the Miami Heat need to sign to fill out this roster and this bench. It's interesting to me that the Bucks, when you look at their rosters right now, they're way deeper.

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Celtics offered Jaylen Brown and two first-round picks for Giannis
quotes.excerpt: Shams also reported that the Celtics actually the offer was Jaylen Brown and two first-round picks.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: Shams also reported that the Celtics actually the offer was Jaylen Brown and two first-round picks for Giannis. Am I crazy? Why not take that?

text_blocks.speaker: Lou Williams
text_blocks.text: Well, I think they got more now and they got more young assets and I don't think they want to pay Jaylen Brown $70 million a year where they're at right now.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown is the next big piece to fall
quotes.excerpt: You know Jaylen Brown knows you just officially made him available.
quotes.quote: You know Jaylen Brown knows you just officially made him available. You know Jaylen Brown is going to be a little bit disgruntled and I think he's the next big piece to fall. Now, if I'm Boston, I'm looking to an Atlanta, I'm looking to a Houston, I'm looking to another one of these teams with a lot of young assets that I can get back that can help me win right now and for the future, because Jaylen Brown's an all-world player.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis may not want to be in Milwaukee long-term
quotes.excerpt: He got to want to be there, especially if he has a destination in mind.
quotes.quote: He got to want to be there, especially if he has a destination in mind that he's trying to get to, say it's LA with the Clippers or it's going back home in Atlanta. And you go out and get him in a trade, if you're Milwaukee, he doesn't really want to be there, he's going to take his money, but at some point eventually he's going to want to step out, he's going to want to go do what he actually wanted to do. So maybe that kind of scared Milwaukee off.

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Bobby Portis is the biggest winner in the Giannis trade
quotes.excerpt: Let's just give a big round of applause to our our friend Bobby Portis.

text_blocks.speaker: Michelle Beadle
text_blocks.text: Let's just give a big round of applause to our our friend Bobby Portis, who I think all four of us were like, yay, he wins.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: And also, and now we know why Taylor Jenkins took this job, right? I guarantee you there was a conversation saying, look, we are going to move Giannis, we are going to get some assets back.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: I've never seen anybody excited to lose with talent. I've never seen that.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Bucks are in a reset, not a rebuild
quotes.excerpt: I think Milwaukee is in a reset, not a restart.
quotes.quote: I think Milwaukee is in a reset, not a restart. It's different. Reset is like, hold on, let's break this down, let me think. Let's reset the table. When you rebuild, knock all this shit off the table.
